data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims reserves at 1 January 2024 were GBP 786.361m. During 2024 there was a small overall favourable prior-year movement: the change in estimates of prior year provisions was a gross release of GBP 3.337m. Management attribute reserve experience to increased catastrophe-related claims in 2024 (including the Baltimore Bridge collision and Hurricanes Helene and Milton), lower prior-year reserve releases compared to the prior year, and continued claims cost inflation which is reflected in reserving reviews. No material per-line prior-year reserve movements are separately quantified in the notes.
raw_causal_phrases: increased claims from net catastrophe losses
lower prior year reserve releases year on year
made appropriate allowance in the reserving analysis and results
case reserves are being reviewed regularly to make sure they adequately allow for the latest inflation trends

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) taken from the Technical Provisions reconciliation table line 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' (gross (3,337) in GBP 700s units). Narrative elsewhere refers to 'lower prior year reserve releases' in net terms; the gross figure was used per instructions. Claims development triangle is present and was used as cross-check; amounts in triangle are presented in GBP 700s (table unit = GBP 7000). No per-line (LOB) prior-year reserve movements are disclosed. An RITC (Syndicate 3334) occurred but is stated to have had no impact on profit or net assets when recorded; this can distort historical comparisons and was noted when assessing triangle reliability.
